title: Risk factors and machine learning prediction models for intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
summary: Retrospective single-center study includes 798 pregnant participants across normal, mild and severe groups, with train/test model comparison. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
